publication.title: AutoPatch: Multi-agent framework for patching real-world CVE vulnerabilities
publication.authors: Seo, Minjae and Choi, Wonwoo and You, Myoungsung and Shin, Seungwon
publication.review_year_basis: initial arXiv submission

extraction.task_output_summary: Matches target code to CVEs, verifies vulnerability presence, explains causes, generates patched code, and revisits it through verifier feedback.
extraction.query: Target-code lexical/context/data-flow features
extraction.knowledge_unit_representation_index: CVE vulnerable/fixed code and descriptions; context vectors; DFG symbols
extraction.selection_filtering_reranking: Keyword/Jaccard/fuzzy plus cosine plus DFG-symbol unified trainable score
extraction.evidence_integration: CVE matching, vulnerability verification, and patch generation. One-shot CoT prompting and verifier feedback condition subsequent generation.
extraction.baselines: Zero-shot same backbones; VSP; transformed-code robustness variants
extraction.evaluation_protocol: 75 recent high-severity CVEs; 525 reimplemented snippets (375 in code-reimplementation evaluation); 70:15:15 similarity-model split; verifier and patch accuracy
extraction.evaluation_context: Linux kernel, Chromium, and related C/C++ systems
extraction.reported_metrics: CVE matching accuracy, vulnerability verification accuracy/F1, joint CoT+vulnerability accuracy/F1, patch accuracy, patch-verification loop count, cost
